name: Portfolio / Personal
description: A personal or professional portfolio one-pager: hero with name, role, intro and social links, an about section with skill chips, a project/work grid, an optional stats band, and a contact call-to-action. Use for 'build me a personal site / portfolio / résumé page for <person>'.

title.description: Browser tab / SEO title (often the person's name).

name.description: The person's name, shown in the header and hero.

initials.description: 1-2 initials for the avatar circle (no photo).

accent.description: Hex accent color. Pick one that suits the person's vibe.

nav.description: Header anchor links. Omit for a bare header.

role.description: Role / title shown as the hero eyebrow (e.g. 'Product Designer & Front-end Engineer').

headline.description: Hero headline — a short personal statement.
headline.default: I design and build calm, useful software.

intro.default: I'm a designer-developer who likes shipping things that feel obvious in hindsight. Currently focused on tools that make complex work feel simple.

secondary_cta.description: Optional secondary button (e.g. résumé). Omit to show only the primary.

socials.description: Social / profile links rendered as small pills (GitHub, LinkedIn, X, email, etc.).

about_body.description: A longer about paragraph. Optional — set to null to hide the about section.
about_body.default: Over the last decade I've worked across early-stage startups and larger product teams, usually at the seam where design meets engineering. I care about typography, fast feedback loops, and interfaces that respect the person using them.

skills.description: Skill / tool chips shown beside the about text.

projects.description: Project cards. Each has a title, an optional year, a one-line description, optional comma-free tag list, and an optional link.

default.title: Helio Dashboard
default.body: A real-time analytics dashboard redesigned around a single glanceable view.

default.title: Field Notes
default.body: An offline-first note app for researchers, built around fast capture.

default.title: Pace
default.body: A team planning tool that turns roadmaps into honest timelines.

default.title: Open-source: rune
default.body: A tiny, dependency-free state library with 4k+ stars.

experience.description: Work history as a vertical timeline, newest first. Each entry has a role, an optional org/company, an optional period (e.g. '2023 — now'), and an optional one-line body. Set to null to hide the section.

default.body: Lead designer for the core product; shipped a ground-up redesign that lifted activation 28%.
Owned design end-to-end across web and mobile at an early-stage startup.
Built and maintained the design system used across a dozen product teams.

stats.description: Optional headline numbers band (e.g. years of experience, projects shipped). Set to null to hide.

contact_subhead.description: Subtext under the contact headline. Optional.
contact_subhead.default: I'm open to select freelance and full-time work. The fastest way to reach me is email.

contact_cta.description: The contact button (often a mailto: link).
